shared_elements: head with headdress or crest at top
arms/limbs bent inward toward the body center
incised or outlined body ornament (bands, discs)
justification: Both depict a single frontal, bilaterally symmetrical figure with a large crowned/crested head above a broad tapering body, with arms bent inward toward the chest and the body decorated with bands and disc-like bosses; the vertical head-torso-flaring-base scheme is comparably organised. The decisive difference is that B is explicitly a raptor-headed being with two huge outspread feathered wings filling the field, whereas A shows no wings or bird features and instead offers a headdressed human-like figure with curvilinear incised motifs and a belt-like band.
